name: Paradise -MUSUBI-
source: This is the first fandisc of Paradise. The fandisc contains the after stories that follow the happy ends of the original game, as well as retellings of some scenes from the original game from the point of view of other characters.
translation: 这是《Paradise》的第一张同人唱片。同人光盘包含原版游戏美好结局之后的后续故事，以及从其他角色的角度重述原版游戏中的一些场景。
